source.quote: after the crash, sync had already relabeled the orphan `cell:active`, and the launch filter accepted only `cell:queued`, so the orphan was never adopted.

prompt: Write adopt.js in the current directory, exporting toLaunch(issues) with CommonJS. issues is an array of {number, labels: [string], hasSession: boolean}. Return the numbers to launch, in input order: every issue labeled cell:queued, plus every issue labeled cell:active that has no session (an orphan left by a crash after its push). Never launch an issue that has a session, and never launch other cell labels such as cell:merged. Reply with the single word done.

checks.name: queued and orphaned active launch; others do not
